violated_contract: A voice that exhausted its initial allowance may receive bounded fresh-PCM recovery only while it is a current calibrated owner near-miss or has no completed decision. Proven rejectors and completed clearly-far voices must receive no extra quota; replayed windows, overlapping capture positions, forged timestamps, failed requests or lifecycle churn must not create unbounded admission or weaken identity authority.
canonical_prevention: Use a per-admitted-voice scalar recovery ledger with physical append and capture-axis high-watermarks, ten new PCM seconds and a monotonic cooldown per grant, at most two three-attempt tranches and a hard eighteen-attempt ceiling. Recheck the existing completed-comparison ledger and calibrated owner near-miss predicate before every extra reservation; refuse proven rejectors and other completed non-near voices without spending quota or granting a tranche. Reserve eligible recovery synchronously through the unchanged socket bucket; failures spend. Preserve carried allowance state, select and pool post-checkpoint PCM before older pending ranges, checkpoint only an admitted fresh query, recheck each increased attempt limit and publish recovery acceptances only through existing arbitration/final authority. Pin eligibility refusals, withdrawn unused quota and profile rechecks through the real runner alongside freshness, lifecycle, diagnostics and fairness guards.
